baslangic.aciklama: Close the app and open it again.

gun.ipucu_1: A rolled wrap is not served until it is papered.
gun.ipucu_2: A burnt skewer holds its slot until it is binned.
gun.ipucu_3: Gold on the ledge is swept in ten seconds, and 30% of it goes.
gun.ipucu_4: Ingredients do not wait for the meat: the bread is enough.
gun.ipucu_5: The higher the tempo, the more everything pays.
gun.ipucu_6: Leave the grill empty and the mince tray starts blinking.

olay.altin_supuruldu: 30% of the gold got swept up

kilit.mangal_3_ne: A third skewer goes on the fire. The one you don't watch burns, and that costs money.
kilit.mangal_4_ne: A fourth slot. The grill runs full, and you are watching four skewers at once.
kilit.bicak_1_ne: An ingredient is two handfuls now, not three.
kilit.bicak_2_ne: An ingredient is one handful. You go to the tray once.
kilit.komur_1_ne: The coals catch quicker, and the meat burns later.
kilit.komur_2_ne: Oak burns hotter: ready sooner, and longer before it burns.
kilit.komur_3_ne: Hard charcoal holds its heat. A shorter cook, and it stays ready longer.
kilit.komur_4_ne: The bellows wake the fire: ready sooner, and more room before it burns.
kilit.komur_5_ne: Good charcoal every day. The fire is at its fastest and the meat at its slowest to burn.
kilit.malzeme_biber_ne: A pepper tray joins the counter: one more thing to put in, one more thing to be asked for.
kilit.malzeme_tursu_ne: Pickles fill the last tray. Now a customer can name two ingredients at once.
kilit.bekleme_2_ne: A second slot on the shelf. One waits while you start the next.
kilit.bekleme_3_ne: A third slot. Three orders can stand ready before the rush.
kilit.musteri_3_ne: A third place at the counter. Three orders at once, three patience bars at once.
kilit.tatli_baklava_ne: One order in three wants baklava too, all of them on a holiday. Off the tray; it pays like a plain wrap.
kilit.icecek_hatti_ne: The glass shelf and the empty glasses arrive. Nothing to fill them with: drinks are bought separately.
kilit.icecek_salgam_ne: The şalgam jug goes on the counter and drink orders start: four orders in ten come with one.
kilit.icecek_ayran_ne: Half the drink orders are ayran now, so a glass poured ahead is a guess.
kilit.icecek_kola_ne: Cola comes from the bottle: no glass, no pouring. A third of the drink orders close in one move.
kilit.bardak_2_ne: A second slot: two glasses wait at once, or one of each drink.
kilit.bardak_3_ne: A third slot: three glasses stand ready. A glass filled with the wrong thing holds one too.
kilit.surahi_ayran_1_ne: A wider mouth: ayran fills a glass a quarter quicker.
kilit.surahi_ayran_2_ne: A second spout: ayran fills in under a second.
kilit.surahi_ayran_3_ne: Ayran fills in about half a second; pouring after the order keeps nobody waiting.
kilit.surahi_salgam_1_ne: A wider mouth: şalgam fills a glass a quarter quicker.
kilit.surahi_salgam_2_ne: A second spout: şalgam fills in under a second.
kilit.surahi_salgam_3_ne: Şalgam fills in about half a second; pouring after the order keeps nobody waiting.
kilit.ikram_1_ne: Everyone waits three seconds longer — enough to finish the wrap in your hand and turn round.
kilit.ikram_2_ne: Three seconds more, six in all — enough to pour a drink and hand it over.
kilit.ikram_3_ne: Nine seconds in all. Worth most on the late days, when patience is shortest.
kilit.kasa_1_ne: Money waits on the ledge three seconds longer, and less of it goes when it is swept.
kilit.kasa_2_ne: Three seconds more, sixteen in all; a swept pile loses a fifth.
kilit.kasa_3_ne: The money waits nineteen seconds and little goes even then — tempo still drops.
kilit.cirak_1_ne: Tempo drops a little slower; on a day that is going well you will not notice it.
kilit.cirak_2_ne: The drop slows noticeably — it earns nothing, it buys time to catch up.
kilit.cirak_3_ne: This is the slowest tempo ever cools; a day that started badly can still be turned round.
kilit.tabela_1_ne: The gap between customers gets shorter; with no free place, still nobody comes in.
kilit.tabela_2_ne: A place that frees up fills sooner; there is less room to take a breath.
kilit.tabela_3_ne: The door now opens faster than you work; the limit is you, not the street.
kilit.kasap_1_ne: The meat itself is worth more; the difference is biggest on a thin wrap.
kilit.kasap_2_ne: As much again. On every wrap, every plate, and bigger with every day.
kilit.kasap_3_ne: The mince gets no better than this. Nothing on the counter changes, only the till.
kilit.porsiyon_hatti_ne: Half the orders become plates: built on their own station, no rolling, no paper.
kilit.bilesen_icli_kofte_ne: The stuffed kofte tray opens: a plate now asks for one thing, and a full plate pays a third more.
kilit.bilesen_pilav_ne: A second component. An order still names one thing, but no longer which.
kilit.bilesen_patates_ne: A third component: three things can go on one plate, and every one of them pays.
kilit.bilesen_ezme_ne: A fourth component. A plate order can now name two things, and one of them may be a refusal.

ozet.reklam_alt: Double the takings with a short video
ozet.hazir: The orders are in — get back to the counter!

ilk_gun.lavas: Take a flatbread and put it on the wrap station.
ilk_gun.bekle: Wait for it to brown. The yellow tick means ready.
ilk_gun.eti_al: Take the meat and put it on the bread.
ilk_gun.malzeme: Add tomato. One ingredient is three handfuls.
ilk_gun.sar: Flick up over the wrap to roll it.
ilk_gun.kagit: Take paper and put it on the rolled wrap.
ilk_gun.altin: Take the money off the counter. Leave it and some of it goes.
ilk_gun.bitti: The counter is yours. Good luck.

olculer.tempo: The dial above the grill is tempo. Right moves lift it, mistakes drop it.
olculer.saat: The clock counts the day. When its rim empties, the doors shut.

gidis.gidis: Every day has a shape: the rush arrives, passes, sometimes returns.

porsiyon.et: Put meat on the plate. No rolling, no paper.

icecek.bardak: Take an empty glass off the shelf.
icecek.dok: Bring the jug to the glass. Filling takes a moment.
icecek.bitti: Cola comes from the bottle and waits for nothing.

grup.mangal_ne: How many skewers cook at once.
grup.bicak_ne: How many handfuls one ingredient takes.
grup.malzeme_ne: How many trays are on the counter, and what goes in a wrap.
grup.bekleme_ne: How many slots the shelf keeps for finished wraps and plates.
grup.musteri_ne: How many people stand at the counter at once.
grup.tatli_ne: A tray of baklava at the end of the counter: nothing to cook, nothing to roll, and the customer will not leave without it.
grup.icecek_ne: The glass shelf, and the drinks the counter carries. An order does not close until the drink is handed over.
grup.bardak_ne: How many glasses you can fill before anyone asks. Filling after the order makes them wait.
grup.ayran_surahisi_ne: How long ayran takes to fill a glass. The şalgam jug climbs separately; this does nothing for it.
grup.salgam_surahisi_ne: How long şalgam takes to fill a glass. The ayran jug climbs separately; this does nothing for it.
grup.ikram_ne: You offer the people waiting something; everyone stands at the counter a few seconds longer.
grup.kasa_ne: Money left on the ledge waits longer, and less of it goes when it is swept up.
grup.cirak_ne: Somebody works beside you: when you fall behind, tempo cools slower.
grup.tabela_ne: The door opens more often — as long as there is a place free.
grup.kasap_ne: Better mince: every wrap and every plate is worth a little more.
grup.porsiyon_ne: A second line: plates are built at their own station, and everything you put on one pays.

kural.denetim_ne: No mistake is forgiven, and everything pays half again.
kural.komur_az_ne: One grill slot is shut, but meat burns slower.
kural.durum_gunu_ne: No plates today, and wraps pay 30% more.
kural.titiz_gun_ne: Everybody asks for one ingredient more.

fayda.malzeme: +{}% on every product it goes into
fayda.hat: A new line opens on the counter
fayda.icecek: +{}% of the main product on every sale
fayda.tatli: +{}% of the main product on every sale
fayda.bicak: An ingredient takes {} handfuls instead of {}
fayda.kasap: The main product is worth {}% more
fayda.kasa: Money sits on the counter {} seconds longer

musteri.siradan_ne: One product, one ask. Most of the day is this.
musteri.aceleci_ne: Short patience, higher pay. Leaves no room for a mistake.
musteri.titiz_ne: Names two things they will not have. One of them ruins the product.
musteri.comert_ne: Tips if you are quick; nothing if they had to wait.
musteri.kararsiz_ne: Changes their mind once while waiting. What you built stays in your hand.
musteri.kalabalik_ne: Two products on one ticket. The place stays taken until both go.

gidis_ne.duz: The same pace all day. The best one to learn on.
gidis_ne.ogle: A rush in the middle, quiet either side.
gidis_ne.cift_servis: Two separate rushes. The lull between them is for prep.
gidis_ne.aksamustu: Heavier towards the end. Fill the shelf early.

tempo_ne.soguk: Takings halve and the meat cooks slowly.
tempo_ne.isiniyor: Takings rise and everyone waits a little longer.
tempo_ne.ates: The best takings and the fastest grill.

rozet_ne.kusursuz: Nothing burnt and nobody left angry.
rozet_ne.hedef: You hit the day’s customer goal.
rozet_ne.seri: You served a long run without a break.
rozet_ne.kurtarici: You caught several people with the bar almost empty.
rozet_ne.ates: You worked the meter up to a blaze.
rozet_ne.dolu: Half again as many customers as the goal asked for.
